items.risk: AI infrastructure demand can be concentrated among large customers and sensitive to hyperscaler capex cycles.
Acquisitions and proposed alliances add integration, execution and capital-allocation risk.
High AI expectations create downside sensitivity if customer capex, mix or margins decelerate.
Value capture can migrate toward customer-owned designs or alternative suppliers even if physical AI buildout continues.
AI capex concentration can create sharp downside if hyperscalers pause or redesign programs.
Capability acquisitions can fail to earn expected returns or create integration drag.
The proposed India alliance could fail to reach definitive documentation or targeted scale.
